description: This file defines API route handlers for task management in a FastAPI application. It provides secured CRUD endpoints allowing users to list, retrieve, create, update, toggle, and delete tasks tied to their user profile. The endpoints interact with a task service for business logic and data persistence, enforcing user-specific access control.
